name: ESP32-S3 Blinky
description: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N8R8): blinks an LED on DO0 (%Q0.0), GPIO15 on header J1 pin 8, every 500 ms with a scan counter. The pin is the one of the board I/O description (firmware/app/boards/boards.json) and of firmware/app/boards/esp32s3_devkitc_esp32s3_procpu.overlay.
author: ZPLC Team

outputs.name: LED_Output
outputs.description: DO0, GPIO15 on header J1 pin 8 (led0): wire an LED with a 330 ohm resistor in series to GND.
